name: grp-mcp-mac
description: Superseded by the grp-mcp plugin, which is cross-platform as of 0.81.0-rc15 and identical to this one; this stays published so existing macOS and Linux installs keep updating. It existed because grp-mcp used to bundle a Windows .exe that a Mac could not execute; both now run the same code from PyPI through uvx, so the split has no purpose left. Install ONE of the two, never both - they register the same server name. Needs uv: 'brew install uv'. Run 'uvx --from grp-mcp-plugin==0.81.0rc31 grp-mcp-setup' once to create your connections file; the server then finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc31): identical to grp-mcp. The green Excel button that loads rows into a table from a .csv or .xlsx file now works - Acumatica had been accepting the file and then quietly writing nothing. A save refused because your session was taken over in another tab is now retried once instead of being lost. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
